assumptions: ideal local gates, storage and measurements
IID Bell-diagonal raw pairs and collective Eve purification
asymptotic information reconciliation and privacy amplification
no finite-key or general coherent-attack claim
security_and_source_model.BB84_policy_information: One fixed ED instrument, fixed per-public-ED-flag B choice and fixed AD input-bit allocations chosen from raw (b,p). Independent tests/observed classical statistics may set universal IR lengths, costs, OTP lengths and abort margins, but do not reselect ED or AD from inferred hidden z.
security_and_source_model.security_implementation: Reconcile all designated public streams independently and use one joint privacy-amplification map. Per-stream positive gross entropy bounds describe the same post-IR cq state; they are not z-dependent retention rules. Net OTP costs remain signed before infimum over z.
security_and_source_model.renewal_qualification: Fix a target number of successful independent ED productions, prove secrecy for the untruncated product process including public histories, then apply raw-budget abort as a subnormalized map. Do not assume conditioning on a raw-budget stopping event preserves product states.
security_and_source_model.OTP_resources: All consumed secret masks are charged, including unsuccessful classical groups as specified by the action. No free mask recycling or constant-size-seed bootstrap is claimed.
security_and_source_model.not_all_experimental_BB84_protocols: Protocols that use ED data to estimate hidden state and then redesign ED/AD are outside the fixed-information optimization.

resource_contract.M: Peak simultaneously live local qubits per party, including incoming ports and ancillas, excluding released measured systems and all classical storage; no uncounted external quantum buffer.
resource_contract.m: Fixed-block input count, or successful ancestry leaves for a recursive construction; not a memory count and not an expected cost.
resource_contract.C: Expected total consumed raw pairs per successful ED output, including every failed attempt and local retry.
resource_contract.n: Number of ED output bits entering one classical AD block; contributes no quantum memory after terminal measurement.
resource_contract.rate_unit: Net secret bits per consumed raw pair; final basis sifting/time-of-flight and hardware clock rate are not included.

M_reporting.complete_rank_one_terminal_measurement: Exact minimum of the specified complete POVM: 1+min_order max_proper_prefix cut_entanglement_rank, with signed streaming compiler. This is not a retained-output or arbitrary coarse-grained-instrument minimum.
M_reporting.recursive_construction: Executable upper bound, minimal only in the registered depth-first plus terminal-reduction schedule class. No arbitrary-circuit memory minimum.
M_reporting.objective_equivalence: Retain the least certified executable M among exactly equivalent catalog records; this operation is not a proof of globally minimal memory for that rate function.

resource_contract.fixed_block: Every attempt consumes all m inputs; public ED flag f contributes P_f/m times its conditional classical rate. All flags are included. An exact terminal-memory compiler alone does not optimize stopping or raw-pair cost.
resource_contract.recursive_retry: Produce a successful child while holding any completed sibling; retry a failed child locally; on parent failure discard both children and restart the parent. C_T=(C_L+C_R)/s_T.
resource_contract.recursive_schedule: M_ret(T)=min(max(M_L,M_R+1),max(M_R,M_L+1)); permitted terminal identities can measure/release child outputs and lower live memory while retaining the same local retry semantics and expected cost.
resource_contract.pooled_B: A separately declared classical layer; each round contributes s_B/2 to yield. Heterogeneous terminal comparison is not silently replaced by same-distribution pooled B.
resource_contract.early_abort_example: The independent ZX example includes a valid optional M=2 early-left-check protocol, but it is not silently added to the fixed-block all-input class or its optimality certificates.

policy_composition.public_ED_flags: One fixed instrument may have different predetermined classical B/AD policies for different public flags; do not replace max_ED inf_z sum_flags by sum_flags max_ED or inf_z max_ED.
policy_composition.recursive_B_prefix: One fixed integer B in 0..16 for a selected recursive ED construction; no mixture across different B prefixes in the declared recursive class.
policy_composition.classical_action_mixtures: Fixed nonnegative rational allocations summing to one, measured in consumed ED-output bits; may mix declared codes and modes without knowledge of z.
policy_composition.BB84_objective: max_fixed_ED,allowed_fixed_B,allowed_fixed_AD_allocations inf_compatible_z net_rate; the infimum includes z-dependent ED yield and signed OTP cost.
policy_composition.state_dependent_upper_relaxation: Allowed only as an upper bound; it is not an implementable lower protocol. A complete-block upper dominated by an independently certified registered lower suffices to close the union gap.

Werner_complete_fixed_terminal.coverage: All fixed one-terminal-bit Clifford rank-one stabilizer-basis measurements, all public ED flags and all nonzero logical duals, modulo exact Werner input symmetry and outcome-frame statistics.
Werner_complete_fixed_terminal.permission: Every retained rate-statistics class has a real H/CNOT terminal realization for IID Werner input; local input rotations can be applied at loading. This symmetry cannot be transferred to arbitrary Bell-diagonal input.
Werner_complete_fixed_terminal.not_claimed: Not all quantum-output Clifford circuits, arbitrary ancillary instruments, adaptive quantum branching, or all protocols of memory <=8.

BB84_complete_fixed_terminal.main_permission: real stabilizer measurements realizable by H/CNOT; all compatible input Bell weights retained without Werner twirl
BB84_complete_fixed_terminal.quotient_restriction: The b=p input-symmetry reduction and all-flag outcome equivalence are not valid automatically for asymmetric inputs or zero-flag-only ablations.
BB84_complete_fixed_terminal.full_rate_certification: Separate full-permission library validation is not proof that every full-permission rate point has been optimized/certified. Read each point evidence.

legacy_registered_recursive.homogeneous_words: All four-decoder words of depth 0..7, with identical successful child states at each level; successful ancestry 2^depth.
legacy_registered_recursive.constant_decoder_raw_pumps: Each of the four decoders repeatedly combines its survivor with one fresh raw pair; successful ancestry 1..160.
legacy_registered_recursive.full_label_meaning: Enlarged terminal-axis permission for the same four real decoder primitives, not all full-Clifford recursive protocols.

exact_objective_quotient.basis: Exact integer polynomial identities for unnormalized Bell weights and retry denominator, up to the eight bit-sector-preserving affine Pauli frames.

finite_classical_class.binary_linear_codes: Every coordinate-permutation class of binary [n,k] code for 1<=n<=8 and 1<=k<=n, including zero columns. These are classical codes, not quantum [[n,k,d]] codes.
finite_classical_class.reduction: Exact direct-sum and zero-column domination by fixed input-bit allocations; signed OTP costs retained. Reduction remains valid under inf_z because the allocation is z-independent.
finite_classical_class.hashed_syndrome_scope: Benchmark uses three Du coefficients, with signed compressed-OTP cost H(S)/n, plus Watanabe. Known-source certificates also transfer to the precisely specified public-tag coefficient h_c=max(r_no,c,r_comp,c) by objective equality. This is not an optimization over every public-hashing protocol.
finite_classical_class.Watanabe: Two-bit hashed two-way classical communication terminal, no secret OTP seed.

theory_vs_numerics.two_qubit_positivity: Ideal two-qubit construction gives positive rate at each fixed Werner Q<1/3 and BB84 b+p<1/2 with sufficiently large finite pumping/AD parameters. Strict interior only; not a finite-cutoff numerical certificate and not a claim that two qubits are necessary.
theory_vs_numerics.boundary: Q=1/3 Werner and a compatible separable BB84 state at b+p=1/2 prevent a strictly positive guaranteed boundary rate.
theory_vs_numerics.free_Y_baseline: Sun arXiv:2410.19334v2 already reaches BB84 Q<1/4 with memory-free Y measurement plus classical processing. Memory improvement must be compared under matched measurement permissions.
theory_vs_numerics.novelty_limits: Do not claim first small-memory purification, first ED+AD framework, first n<=5 general-Bell/n<=8 Werner enumeration, or a general CRO 20%/27.6% converse.
theory_vs_numerics.point_evidence_rule: Only certified_optimum carries a complete finite-class upper. Dense Werner selected-policy enclosures certify feasibility, not a complete-class optimum. No continuum optimality is inferred.

known_Werner.reason: Known-source menu equality holds separately in every ED flag pool; same ED, B, codes, yields, costs and memory. No change to positive parts or syndrome-dependent mode selection.

BB84_unknown_z.reason: max inside inf_z need not equal fixed-mode or fixed-mixture benchmark; multi-state duals require a separate check.

public_hash_scope.not_claimed: Optimality of every public-hashed transcript; universal uselessness of OTP; new invention of hashed reconciliation.

explicitly_deferred_or_excluded: outcome-dependent redesign from estimated hidden state
arbitrary noisy quantum memories or gates
general BB84 public-tag max-min optimum unless separately certified
all public-hashing protocols beyond the specified coefficient menu

known_Werner.reason: Known-source menu equality holds separately in every ED flag pool; same ED, B, codes, yields, costs and memory. No change to positive parts or syndrome-dependent mode selection.

BB84_unknown_z.reason: max inside inf_z need not equal fixed-mode or fixed-mixture benchmark; multi-state duals require a separate check.

detail.not_claimed: Optimality of every public-hashed transcript; universal uselessness of OTP; new invention of hashed reconciliation.
